desc.nav: Master the awesome power of Spinjitzu as you clean out the teens’ refrigerator.
Chiến đấu qua các đợt tấn công của Chiến binh Cá mập để đạt được trận quyết đấu cuối cùng với Garmadon.
Use the power of Jay’s ninja launcher to fly through the sky, collecting as many coins as you can.
Use your arrow flinging skills to take down Garmadon’s army – but watch out for civilians!
Achieve the ultimate state of fearlessness as you follow Kai’s lead, learning the art of Kai-Chi.
Use Cole’s hammer to whack as many Shark Warriors as you can before time runs out!
